title: Should Benevolent Deception be Allowed in EHMI? A Mechanism Explanation Based on Game Theory
reasoning: The paper explores the ethical and moral implications of 'benevolent deception' in autonomous vehicle communication (EHMI). It specifically evaluates whether robots should be permitted to mislead humans for safety benefits, referencing Isaac Asimov's Three Laws of Robotics and dedicating a significant portion of the discussion to ethical and societal development considerations.
